learning_objective: The learner can define instruction-following capability and explain how scoring rubrics, examples, and defined evaluation criteria are used to measure how well a model adheres to user constraints.

common_misconceptions.description: Instruction-following failure is often confused with a lack of domain-specific knowledge or generation capability.
Poor model performance is assumed to be the model's fault without considering that the instruction itself may be bad.
Instruction following is treated as a strict pass/fail rather than a partial score based on meeting multiple criteria.
